name: Glorin Steelbrow
summary: Glorin Steelbrow is a dwarven operative found drinking at the Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor. Acting as an associate of Bishop Farthing in Darkshire, he helps adventurers investigate the lost Third Fleet and recover sacred relics and materials scattered across the Wetlands coast. His efforts tie the haunted wilderness of Duskwood directly to the sunken shipwrecks of the north.

sections.title: A Harbor Connection
sections.body: While Bishop Farthing oversees the spiritual and martial defense of Darkshire against the creeping terrors of Duskwood, he maintains ties far to the north in Menethil Harbor. Stationed inside the bustling Deepwater Tavern, Glorin Steelbrow acts as Farthing's eyes and hands on the coast. He offers aid and direction to travelers sent north in search of sacred metals and forgotten relics, providing a crucial bridge between the troubles of the southern forest and the sunken wreckage of the Wetlands.

sections.title: The Doomed Fleet and Lost Relics
sections.body: Steelbrow is intimately familiar with the tragedy of the Third Fleet, whose ships were battered and dragged beneath the waves along the Wetlands shore. He guides adventurers to scour the haunted wreckage for lost ingots of Lightforge iron and the powerful, cursed artifact known as the Eye of Paleth. Glorin knows that recovering such holy armaments is vital for forging weapons capable of holding back the dark forces threatening the Alliance.

faq.answer: Glorin Steelbrow is a dwarf stationed in the Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor. He works in coordination with Bishop Farthing of Darkshire, assisting adventurers who travel north to salvage sunken cargo and relics off the Wetlands coast.

faq.q: Where can I find Glorin Steelbrow?
faq.answer: Glorin is located on the ground floor of the Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor, situated on the western coast of the Wetlands.

faq.q: Why is a dwarf in Menethil Harbor involved with Duskwood?
faq.answer: Bishop Farthing in Darkshire requires powerful holy relics and consecrated metals to fight the darkness encroaching on Duskwood. He sends trusted emissaries to Glorin Steelbrow, who knows the Wetlands coast and can point salvagers toward the sunken remains of the Third Fleet.

faq.q: What is the Third Fleet that Glorin talks about?
faq.answer: The Third Fleet was an Alliance naval expedition that met catastrophe off the coast of the Wetlands. Its shattered hulls now litter the seabed, haunted by drowned sailors and hiding valuable cargo like Lightforge iron and ancient artifacts.

faq.q: What is the Eye of Paleth?
faq.answer: The Eye of Paleth is an ancient religious relic carried aboard the sunken fleet. Once recovered from the ocean floor with Glorin's guidance, it must undergo cleansing by the priesthood due to the dark corruption lingering around the shipwreck.

faq.q: What is Lightforge iron used for?
faq.answer: Lightforge iron is a rare, sanctified metal used to craft blessed weapons capable of striking down powerful undead and demonic forces. Glorin helps recover lost ingots from the shipwrecks to aid the defenders of Duskwood.

angles.text: Glorin represents dwarven enterprise and solidarity, coordinating from the maritime hub of Menethil Harbor to support allies across Khaz Modan and the southern human kingdoms.
Paladins following Farthing's orders will find Glorin indispensable in recovering Lightforge iron, a sacred metal essential for crafting weapons blessed by the Holy Light.
Glorin plays a key role in recovering crucial Alliance military relics and sanctified materials lost during naval disasters in the Wetlands.
